section_summary: This section moves from 1938 reports on Japanese fishing ventures in Panama and Costa Rica to earlier records concerning Japanese fisheries vessels in Alaskan waters. It also contains cross-reference sheets, a report on Japanese fishing law, pearl-culture correspondence, and exchanges about visits by the Hakuyo Maru and Hakuho Maru in 1930. Several documents appear here only as file notes pointing to records filed elsewhere.

subfiles.title: Japanese Attempts to Extend Fishing Activities to Panama
subfiles.about: Panama plans to bar Japanese deep-sea fishing in its waters.
subfiles.summary: Boyce reports Consul General Briceño's support for ending Japanese fishing privileges and Amano's unsuccessful attempt to obtain Costa Rican registry.

subfiles.title: Rights of aliens under Japanese fishing laws
subfiles.about: Points to a despatch on aliens under Japanese fishing law.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to despatch 2732 concerning alien fishing rights and definitions in Japanese law.

subfiles.title: Rights of aliens under the fishing laws of Japan
subfiles.about: Explains the legal and administrative limits on aliens working in Japanese fisheries.
subfiles.summary: The despatch translates ordinances governing alien labor and discusses licensing throughout Japan's fishing industry. It argues that broad administrative discretion permits officials to exclude aliens without explicit discriminatory language, and compares this practice with immigration restrictions.

subfiles.title: Canadian restrictions on Japanese-origin fishermen
subfiles.about: Points to a despatch on proposed Canadian immigration and fishing-license restrictions.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to despatch 1894 on growing hostility toward Japanese people in Canada.

subfiles.title: Sale of Japanese-owned fishing vessels
subfiles.about: Points to a despatch confirming vessel sales to Panamanians.
subfiles.summary: Notes the sales of Yamato Maru and Margarita and reported sales of Italian-owned craft.

subfiles.title: Restriction of Fishing in Panamanian Territorial Waters to Nationals
subfiles.about: Reports enforcement of Panama's ban on alien fishing and related vessel sales.
subfiles.summary: Corrigan discusses an editorial alleging Japanese seizures of vessels with recent Panamanian registry, then reports invalidation of alien fishing licenses. Notarial records confirm the sale of two Japanese-owned fishing vessels to Panamanians.

subfiles.title: Forfeiture proceedings against fishing vessels
subfiles.about: Points to litigation concerning six vessels and Japanese subjects.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to forfeiture proceedings involving Nancy Hanks, West Maco, Standard, Costa Rica, Three Star, and Cleopatra.

subfiles.title: Unidentified handwritten note
subfiles.about: A brief handwritten note is largely illegible in the OCR.
subfiles.summary: Brief, largely illegible handwritten note.

subfiles.title: Pacific Refrigeration Company and fishing vessel Amano
subfiles.about: Reports a possible business link between a Puntarenas refrigeration plant and Japanese fishing interests.
subfiles.summary: A source says the Amano was sent to seek registry and deliver fish to Pacific Refrigeration.

subfiles.title: Relations between Pacific Refrigeration Company and Amano
subfiles.about: Points to further information from Puntarenas about the Amano.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to despatch 204 on Collins's conversation with the Captain of the Port.

subfiles.title: Japanese activities in Costa Rica
subfiles.about: Points to information supplied by a Puntarenas fish-packing plant owner.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to despatch 138 on Dara M. Kittle's account of the Amano.

subfiles.title: Bering Sea Patrol reports and Freeman correspondence
subfiles.about: Forwards correspondence and recent patrol findings on Japanese fishing.
subfiles.summary: Reports that salmon seen aboard a Japanese launch were probably food or incidental catch.

subfiles.title: Owner of Japanese steamship Amano again seeks Costa Rican registration
subfiles.about: Reports Amano's renewed attempt to obtain Costa Rican registry.
subfiles.summary: Local press says Amano returned to San José despite an earlier denial of registry.

subfiles.title: Japanese Activities in Costa Rica
subfiles.about: Reports official resistance to registering Amano's vessel and fishery company.
subfiles.summary: Colonel Cañas says Costa Rican authorities distrust Japanese proposals and have resisted registry for the Amano. Hornibrook encloses a check of the company's pending registration.

subfiles.title: Amano Fishery Company, S.A.
subfiles.about: Describes the company's pending registration and officers.
subfiles.summary: Registration remains incomplete because the vessel's Costa Rican registry is unproven.

subfiles.title: Japan's Whaling Industry
subfiles.about: Relays a report of planned Japanese whaling in the Arctic.
subfiles.summary: Carver forwards news of a planned Arctic expedition by the floating factory Tonan Maru.

subfiles.title: Amano's attempt to obtain Costa Rican registry
subfiles.about: Analyzes Amano's public statement seeking Costa Rican registry.
subfiles.summary: Pate reports Amano's stated aim of registering his vessel and warns that approval could attract other Japanese-crewed vessels.

subfiles.title: Interview with Yoshitaro Amano
subfiles.about: Amano advocates Costa Rican registry and a fishing base at Puntarenas.
subfiles.summary: Amano argues that foreign fishing fleets would bring trade to Puntarenas and discusses Japanese cotton, coffee, and cassava commerce. He rejects allegations of espionage and says he seeks Costa Rican registry for his vessel.

subfiles.title: File-stamp leaves
subfiles.about: Two leaves contain filing marks without readable document text.
subfiles.summary: Only State Department filing marks and file number are legible.

subfiles.title: Costa Rican registry granted to Amano
subfiles.about: Points to a despatch reporting Costa Rican registry for the Amano.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to despatch 464 on registration of the Japanese fishing vessel.

subfiles.title: Enclosure charge slip
subfiles.about: Tracks circulation of an enclosure in the file.
subfiles.summary: Administrative charge slip with dates and clerk initials.

subfiles.title: Arrest of Japanese pearling vessels off Arnhem Land
subfiles.about: Points to a report on Australian arrests of Japanese pearling vessels.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to despatch 27 concerning the patrol vessel Larrakia.

subfiles.title: Japanese fishing in northern waters
subfiles.about: Points to an article on Japanese fishing in northern waters.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to despatch 4055 enclosing the South Sea Association bulletin.

subfiles.title: Pearls enclosure charge slip
subfiles.about: Tracks an enclosure in the pearls file.
subfiles.summary: Administrative charge slip bearing a pearls file reference.

subfiles.title: Commendation of pearl-culture report
subfiles.about: Praises Consul Spamer's report on pearl culture and marketing.
subfiles.summary: Grab recommends placing his commendation in Spamer's personnel file.

subfiles.title: Excellent rating for pearl-culture report
subfiles.about: Notifies Tokyo that Spamer's report received an excellent rating.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Commerce's commendation and asks that Spamer be informed.

subfiles.title: Pearl oyster beds of Japan
subfiles.about: Points to a despatch on mass pearl-oyster mortality.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to despatch 776 attributing oyster losses to microscopic poisonous plants.

subfiles.title: Destruction of pearl oyster beds
subfiles.about: Points to a report on alleged pearl-oyster bed destruction.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to commercial attaché report 9.

subfiles.title: Activities of the Hakuho Maru at Alaskan ports
subfiles.about: Requests representations over alleged theft from native fish nets and unannounced visits.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Cochran's patrol report and asks Japan to investigate and seek permission before visiting Alaskan ports.

subfiles.title: Bering Sea Patrol report on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Details the vessel's calls near the Aleutians and an alleged theft from native nets.
subfiles.summary: Cochran recommends advance permission for Japanese investigations in American waters.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs view of Hakuho Maru visits
subfiles.about: Advises requesting notice for visits to American territorial waters.
subfiles.summary: The division also supports raising the reported theft of fish from Attu nets.

subfiles.title: Request for comments on Coast Guard complaint
subfiles.about: Seeks views on whether Treasury should raise the Hakuho Maru matter with Japan.
subfiles.summary: Hickerson asks for comments to relay to Captain Root.

subfiles.title: Coast Guard request for notice of Japanese patrols
subfiles.about: Asks that Japan advise Treasury before sending vessels into the Bering Sea.
subfiles.summary: Root encloses Cochran's report and cites the history of the international seal patrol.

subfiles.title: Duplicate Bering Sea Patrol report on Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Repeats the patrol account of Hakuho Maru's Aleutian visits.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate report alleges theft from native nets at Attu and recommends advance permission.

subfiles.title: Previous Japanese notice and recent Hakuho Maru complaint
subfiles.about: Reviews the 1924 Japanese notice and the 1929 Coast Guard complaint.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum recounts advance notice of an earlier fur-seal research voyage and later reports of unannounced Hakuho Maru visits and alleged theft at Attu.

subfiles.title: Reply to Treasury concerning Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Promises to seek advance notice of future Hakuho Maru visits.
subfiles.summary: State will approach Japan so American officials can prepare for visits to Alaskan ports.

subfiles.title: Oral communication on Hakuho Maru visits
subfiles.about: Requests advance notice of intended visits to Alaskan ports.
subfiles.summary: The communication recalls Japan's 1924 itinerary notice and says subsequent unannounced calls caused confusion for local American officials.

subfiles.title: Inquiry on Japanese observers at the Pribilof Islands
subfiles.about: Asks whether Japan plans to send a fur-seal observer to the Pribilofs.
subfiles.summary: The inquiry would allow arrangements for quarters and facilities.

subfiles.title: Proposed Japanese fur-seal observer
subfiles.about: Requests an inquiry about a Japanese observer at the Pribilof Islands.
subfiles.summary: Commerce seeks time to arrange quarters and facilities if Japan sends a representative.

subfiles.title: Reply to Commerce on Japanese fur-seal observers
subfiles.about: Reports inquiries to Japan and encloses the earlier Hakuho Maru communication.
subfiles.summary: State says it asked the embassy about a Pribilof observer and requested advance notice of Alaskan port visits.

subfiles.title: Proposed cruise of the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Announces a fisheries training cruise to Alaskan waters.
subfiles.summary: The embassy gives the Hakuyo Maru's crew and student numbers, expected itinerary, and request for customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Hakuyo Maru notice to Commerce
subfiles.about: Requests facilities for the Hakuyo Maru at Dutch Harbor and the Pribilofs.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the embassy note and asks Commerce to instruct its local representatives.

subfiles.title: Hakuyo Maru notice to Treasury
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for the Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the Japanese note and asks Treasury to instruct its representatives.

subfiles.title: Interior arrangements for Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Records an oral check on facilities for the vessel.
subfiles.summary: Interior's chief clerk says Alaska's governor was instructed to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Hakuyo Maru notice to Interior
subfiles.about: Requests facilities for the Hakuyo Maru at Alaskan ports.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the embassy note and asks Interior to instruct its representatives.

subfiles.title: Commerce acknowledgment concerning Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions to extend facilities to the Hakuyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Commerce's Bureau of Fisheries has notified its representatives.

subfiles.title: Temporary landing of Hakuyo Maru students
subfiles.about: Approves treating the ship's students as temporary through passengers.
subfiles.summary: Labor raises no objection to their landing without documents under the cited regulation and notifies its Ketchikan director.

subfiles.title: Treasury acknowledgment concerning Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms customs arrangements for the vessel's Alaskan calls.
subfiles.summary: The Juneau collector may extend customary courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Visa requirements for Hakuyo Maru crew and students
subfiles.about: Analyzes crew-list visa rules and temporary admission of students.
subfiles.summary: The office concludes that the non-warship needs a visaed crew list and proposes asking Labor whether students qualify as temporary through passengers.

subfiles.title: Inquiry to Labor about Hakuyo Maru students
subfiles.about: Seeks a ruling on temporary admission of the ship's students.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether the students can land without documents as through passengers during Alaskan port calls.

subfiles.title: Conversation about Hakuyo Maru visit
subfiles.about: Informally confirms facilities and mentions the crew-list visa requirement.
subfiles.summary: Ballantine says an official reply will follow and calls attention to the visa rule.

subfiles.title: Reply to Japanese Embassy concerning Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms customary facilities for the vessel and its personnel.
subfiles.summary: State acknowledges the planned cruise and reports assurances from the relevant authorities.

subfiles.title: Proposed cruise of the Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Announces an Aleutian fur-seal observation cruise.
subfiles.summary: The embassy identifies the captain and crew and requests facilities if weather or other needs bring the vessel to the islands.

subfiles.title: Hakuho Maru notice to Treasury
subfiles.about: Requests instructions for possible Hakuho Maru calls in the Aleutians.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Japan's notice and asks Treasury to extend facilities and report its action.

subfiles.title: Hakuho Maru notice to Interior
subfiles.about: Requests facilities for possible Hakuho Maru calls.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Japan's notice and requests instructions to Interior's representatives.

subfiles.title: Hakuho Maru notice to Commerce
subfiles.about: Requests facilities for the fur-seal observation cruise.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Japan's note and asks Commerce to advise its representatives.

subfiles.title: Treasury acknowledgment concerning Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms customs authorization for the Hakuho Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Juneau collector has authority to extend customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Commerce acknowledgment and concern about Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms facilities and suggests Coast Guard observation of the vessel.
subfiles.summary: Commerce notes repeated extended cruises and asks that their purpose be investigated.
